description: This file defines a custom exception class `MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException` used to indicate invalid configuration of a message mapper within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. The class includes methods for creating instances from messages and JSON objects, and a builder class for constructing instances with detailed properties.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception for invalid message mapper configuration.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException with fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with the missing configuration property.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
